items.name: use-count-up

items.name: use-in-view-video
items.title: Use In View Video
items.description: Plays a muted background video while it is in view and pauses it when it leaves, when the tab is hidden, or when the user pauses it.

items.name: use-kit-portal
items.title: Use Kit Portal
items.description: The element overlays should render into, so they keep the kit's CSS variables.

items.name: use-marquee
items.title: Use Marquee
items.description: An endless horizontal scroll at a fixed speed in px per second.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: Use Reduced Motion
items.description: Whether the user asked the system for less motion.

items.name: use-reveal
items.title: Use Reveal
items.description: Tells an element when it scrolls into view, for entrance animations and staged (staggered) entrances.

items.name: use-scroll-progress
items.title: Use Scroll Progress
items.description: How far an element has travelled through the viewport, from 0 to 1, for scroll-scrubbed video, parallax and progress bars.

items.name: use-scroll-state
items.title: Use Scroll State
items.description: Whether the page has scrolled past a threshold, and which way it last moved.

items.name: use-tilt
items.title: Use Tilt
items.description: 3D tilt and pointer follow for cards.
